findings.title: Homepage fetch did not return usable page content
findings.evidence: Fetch classified as error (HTTP 404 stub); status=404; preview='Not found'. On-page identity and engagement checks were not run against this body.

suggested_action.summary: This fetch received an error stub or bot-check page, not the real homepage. Retry from a normal browser session or allow simple HTTP clients; do not treat this as a fact about the brand's content or identity.

findings.title: Named AI-crawler block in robots.txt
findings.evidence: Named AI user-agents root-disallowed in https://www.patagonia.com/robots.txt. live-agent=[]; training-crawler=['Google-Extended'].

suggested_action.summary: Training-crawler user-agents are root-disallowed. If that is an intentional training opt-out, no change is required for live citation.

findings.title: Sitemap missing or unreachable

suggested_action.summary: No sitemap document was reachable at the declared or default locations from this fetch. If one is published, declare it with a Sitemap: line in robots.txt and ensure that URL returns XML.
